name: Ansible
subtitle: Configuration management and automation
creator: Michael DeHaan
description: A tool that configures servers by describing the desired state in YAML playbooks: install these packages, copy these files, restart this service. It connects over SSH, so no agent software is needed on the servers.

concepts.explanation: The list of servers to manage.
Reusable actions like apt or copy.
Running twice gives the same result.

codeSamples.label: YAML · playbook.yml
codeSamples.code:
- name: Set up web servers
  hosts: web
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install nginx
      apt:
        name: nginx
        state: present
    - name: Make sure nginx is running
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: started

pairsWith.reason: Terraform creates servers, Ansible configures them

cons: Less useful with serverless or PaaS

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Red Hat sells Ansible Automation Platform.
